name: Ragtop
author: Stan Clemance
description: Tablet mode plus an on-screen keyboard (OSK). Omarchy-themed keycaps: Mobile, 60%, 75% or 80% tenkeyless (TKL). Auto-resize and auto-rotate via the accelerometer, or lock the orientation. Follows your layout to dead keys and AltGr. Beta: swipe typing, word suggestions, and Chinese, Japanese, Korean (CJK) input. Fold or detach a convertible 2-in-1: it auto-detects tablet mode. Use it by touchscreen or by mouse for kiosks. Touch resizes, moves and swaps Omarchy tiles. Tested on Yoga and Surface.

barWidget.description: The on-screen keyboard and screen rotation, always in the bar, plus tiling mode while the machine is a tablet
